title: Urtica dioica tincture for medicinal use
intro: Urtica dioica tincture is a liquid preparation made by soaking the leaves and stems of the stinging nettle plant in alcohol or another solvent. It is commonly used in herbalism to support urinary tract health and as a diuretic. This tincture is also valued for its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of arthritis. It may be used to help manage conditions like gout and kidney stones due to its high mineral content. In traditional medicine, it has been employed to detoxify the body and enhance overall vitality.
